data.name: Mariyah
data.gender_notes: Mariyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mother of Jesus in Christianity, and one of the purest and most beloved women in Islam. The name Mariyah carries the meaning “Mary” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, English. Parents who choose Mariyah usually hope their child will grow to embody mary and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of purity, submission, and obedience to Allah
data.etymology: Mariyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mary.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mariyah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: ماريه
in_arabic.meaning: الماريه امرأة من أهل مدينة طائف
in_arabic.long_meaning: الماريه امرأة من أهل مدينة طائف، وهي إحدى السيدات الذين نزل القرآن الكريم في قصة محبة الرسول سيدنا محمدpeace be upon him لهم وتناقلهم، فكانت الماريه من بين السيدات الذين أرسلهن إلى سيدنا محمدpeace be upon him، واقرتهن على رسالته، وكنّ من أولى المشركين الذين أسلموا، وكانت الماريه إحدى السيدات الذين كانوا يعجبهن سيدنا محمدpeace be upon him، فكانت الماريه من أوائل السيدات الذين أسلموا، وكانت الماريه من أسماء السيدات الذين كانوا يعجبهن سيدنا محمدpeace be upon him، وكنّ من أولى المشركين الذين أسلموا

in_urdu.name: ماریہ
in_urdu.meaning: ماریہ طائف کی ایک خاتون کا نام ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ماریہ طائف کی ایک خاتون کا نام ہے، جو کہ قریش کے قبیلہ سے تعلق رکھتی ہے۔ اس کے والد کا نام ابو سلمہ ہے، جو کہ اپنے وقت کا ایک غنی اور بڑا人物 تھا۔ ماریہ کا ذکر قرآن میں واقعہ طائف میں ہے، جہاں کے لوگ رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی دعوت کی نافرمانی کرتے ہوئے اپنے دین کی جانب سے ان کے خلاف جنگ کر رہے تھے۔ ماریہ اور ان کے والد ابو سلمہ، رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی طرف سے ان کے دین کی دعوت کے لئے آئے۔

in_hindi.name: मारियाह
in_hindi.meaning: मारियाह एक महिला का नाम है जो तायफ की रहने वाली थी
in_hindi.long_meaning: मारियाह एक महिला का नाम है जो तायफ की रहने वाली थी, जो कि कुरैश के कबीले से संबंध रखती थी। उसके पिता का नाम अबू सलमा था, जो अपने समय का एक अमीर और बड़ा व्यक्ति था। मारियाह का उल्लेख कुरआन में तायफ के विवाद में है, जहां के लोग अल्लाह के रसूल मोहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि व सल्लम की दावत की नाफरमानी करते हुए अपने धर्म के दुश्मन हो गए थे। मारियाह और उसके पिता अबू सलमा, अल्लाह के रसूल मोहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि व सल्लम की ओर से उनके धर्म की दावत के लिए आए।

in_english.name: Mariyah
in_english.meaning: Mariyah is a lady of the people of Taif and a member of the Quraysh tribe
in_english.long_meaning: Mariyah is a lady of the people of Taif, a member of the Quraysh tribe, whose father was Abu Salmah. She is mentioned in the Quran in the story of the incident of Taif, where the people of Taif refused the call of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, and fought against him. Mariyah and her father Abu Salmah came to the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, to invite them to Islam. Mariyah and her father Abu Salmah were among the first people to accept Islam and became among the first people to support the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, in his mission.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Mariyah is associated with the Blessed Virgin Mary. Maryiyah is considered a beautiful and radiant name that signifies purity, faith, and submission to God. Her story is deeply rooted in Islamic tradition, and her status as a revered prophetess is acknowledged and celebrated among Muslims. In certain Sufi circles, Maryam is also beloved as an embodiment of spiritual longing and divine love for the Divine.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mariyah holds great spiritual significance in Islam, as it reminds us of Maryam's unwavering faith and devotion to God. It also serves as an inspiration for all believers to strive for purity of heart and character. Maryam'sChecked story in the Quran teaches us about the importance of patience, submission to God's will, and the worthiness of putting our trust in Him. The name Mariyah evokes a sense of peace, reverence, and humility, leading us to reflect on our spiritual growth and the role of faith in our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mariyah is an Arabic name meaning "exalted one", evoking the spiritual elevation and purity of Mary, the beloved mother of Prophet Jesus (peace be upon him) in Islamic tradition. Her name symbolizes devotion, submission, and the highest form of motherly love.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mariyah bint Sa'd ibn Mu'adh, a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Mariyah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mariyah was a noblewoman from the Banu Zayd tribe of Mecca who embraced Islam and became a close companion of the Prophet Muhammad. She was known for her generosity and piety, and was one of the first women to pledge allegiance to the Prophet as a Muslim.
